fees.source: ReserveAmerica's price block on the site page(s) for one night (read 2026-11-10): 'Residents of PA $10.00 Per Night, $70.00 Per Week', 'Non-Residents $15.00 Per Night, $105.00 Per Week', 'Reservation Fees $6.50'. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

note: Sites 023 and 028 on the south side of Paddy Mountain Road, about 0.8 km apart, one camping unit each. 023 is at the Weikert Trail crossing (trail users pass) and its 267-ft gravel driveway is graded severe, dropping about 6 m from the road. 028, just east of Cherry Run Road, is a small site with a posted overhead clearance of 10 ft under closed canopy: not for a rig taller than that. Fire rings and picnic tables, nothing else. Reached from Old Turnpike Road (PA 45) by Bear Run Road and Woodward Gap Road, about 4 miles. On 2026-11-10 ReserveAmerica showed both sites as Not Available on every night checked through September 2027, with no reason posted. State forest roads are not plowed in winter, and some Bald Eagle roads need 4WD and high clearance: check the route. --Claude
summary: Both site pages re-read: open year round, prices shown ($10/$15 + $6.50), but NOT bookable on any night queried. 023: 50 ft, back-in gravel, SEVERE driveway 267 ft, 14-ft clearance. 028: 50 ft, 10-ft overhead clearance, moderate driveway 200 ft, site 38 x 25 ft. sites.count 2 -> 1 (028 fails on clearance). Imagery rendered, leaf-on closed canopy at both: no pad visible, no open sky over 028. 3DEP: 023 pin 5.6 m below the road 80 m away (7% mean), 028 pin 5.8 m below the road 62 m away (9% mean). No NHD flowline within 200 m of either.
flags: CANNOT CURRENTLY BE BOOKED ONLINE: every site of this entry showed 'Not Available' on every night queried on 2026-11-10 (Nov 17-30 2026, May 12-25 2027, Jul 14-27 2027; also Dec 15-28 2026, Mar 15-28 2027 and Sep 20-Oct 3 2027 for 023), and the forest's site-list grid shows the same X ('Not avail.') while neighbouring sites (021, 027, 030, 031, 034, 064-066) are open or reserved. The pages are NOT labelled 'Walkup Only' and still show prices, so booking was left as reservable. No reason found on the site pages, the ReserveAmerica forest alerts or the DCNR Bald Eagle advisories page (its only advisory is the Pine Creek Hollow Road bridge closure from May 26 2026). The same block covers 022, 029 and 041, i.e. the Paddy Mountain / Cherry Run / Old Mingle / Poe Paddy group plus Hunter Road 069-070. Owner question: keep with the dated caveat (written into the note), or hold/drop until DCNR reopens them? A call to the district would settle why.

028 OVERHEAD CLEARANCE: 'Overhead Clearance: 10' (ft) on the booking page; imagery (leaf-on) shows unbroken canopy over the pin, no open sky. A rig just under 10.5 ft does not clear it, so 028 was taken out of sites.count (2 -> 1).

023 DRIVEWAY: 'Driveway Grade: Severe', 267 ft; 3DEP puts the pad about 5.6 m below Paddy Mountain Road over 80 m (7% mean, steeper pitches likely). If a severe gravel driveway rules a 23-ft motorhome out, NO site of this entry is usable and it is a drop candidate.

DCNR GIS layer (2022-12-20): 023 TrailerAccess 'No' ('In old burn and planted area'), 028 TrailerAccess 'No' ('Small site'), against the booking pages' 50-ft max vehicle length and 'Tent Site, Trailer Site'.
No 'RV Site' among the equipment categories on any Bald Eagle site page in this entry (both 'Tent Site, Trailer Site'): by the brief that is keep, flagged.
